sources.snippet: PI0.5 Four-Suite Few-Shot Model for LIBERO This package contains all ten RLinf-native, consolidated PI0.5 checkpoints from a few-shot fine-tuning run on libero_spatial, libero_object, libero_goal, and libero_10. Checkpoints are provided every 2,000 steps from global_step_2000 through global_step_20000.
